KindleTrail_Text_Npc0.en: Hit hard, stay humble. That is the\nway.
KindleTrail_Text_Npc0.fr: Frappe fort, reste humble. C'est la\nvoie.

KindleTrail_Text_Npc1.en: TYROGUE grows into three forms.\nTrain it well!

KindleTrail_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Strong body needs PROTEIN. Bring\none, get a FOCUS BAND.
KindleTrail_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Un corps fort a besoin de PROTÉINE.\nApportes-en une, reçois une BANDE\lFOCUS.

KindleTrail_Text_Quest0_MissT.en: One PROTEIN, please. The APOTHECARY\nsells it.
KindleTrail_Text_Quest0_MissT.fr: Une PROTÉINE, s'il vous plaît.\nL'APOTHICAIRE en vend.

KindleTrail_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
KindleTrail_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

KindleTrail_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

KindleTrail_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
KindleTrail_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.

KindleTrail_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
KindleTrail_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
